concerns.text: FR-004 mandates simulating retrieval ranking based on 'both topological signatures (via graph similarity) and neural embeddings'. Tasks T022 and T023 explicitly restrict ranking to 'TF-IDF Cosine Similarity' only and state topological signatures are extracted 'ONLY from the set of documents returned by the TF-IDF ranking'. This silently removes the required graph-based ranking implementation, violating the functional requirement to compare two distinct ranking methods.

FR-007 requires enforcing a 'time limit for the entire pipeline execution' ensuring N*60s <= 6h. Task T008 only addresses the 'sample size constraint (N ≤ 360)' and truncation logic. It lacks a task to implement the actual runtime monitoring or enforcement mechanism (e.g., timeout wrapper, wall-clock tracking) required to guarantee the 6-hour CI budget is not exceeded during execution.

SC-005 requires measuring the statistical significance (p-value) of a paired t-test against a 'predetermined alpha level'. Task T029 only asks to log the Recall@10 ratio and check a 0.70 threshold, omitting the explicit implementation of the t-test significance check against the alpha level required by the success criterion.

SC-001 requires measuring correlation between 'average modularity of retrieved documents' and Recall@k. Task T032 asks to log a generic 'status field' and r-value but does not explicitly verify that the correlation calculation is performed specifically on the *retrieved* subset as defined in the success criterion, risking calculation on the full corpus.
